decisions.reason: Confirmed missing equilibrium hypothesis: the original Postulate calls p0 the full pressure of a resting uniformly stratified state, sets pi=(p-p0)/rho0, but explicitly leaves p0 arbitrary. The background force -grad(p0)/rho0+(B0-g)e3 then need not vanish; p0=0 would require B0=g, inconsistent with B0'=N^2>0. This is a logical defect in the stated resting-state linearization, although the separately adopted perturbation PDEs remain meaningful. Repaired by prescribing B0(z)=B_*+N^2 z and grad(p0)/rho0=(B0-g)e3, preserving every displayed equation and the separate shallow-water branch.

Density applicability remains local and empirical adequacy is not inferred. Rotation signs, domains, regularity, units, every displayed equation, shallow-water assumptions and source links are preserved. Both actual direct consumers remain sound under their unchanged statements and proofs. No diagrams occur or are required for this pointwise model formulation. Scoped nonproof, render, strict-contract and final proof-layout checks passed; current review hashes were obtained immediately after completing this review.
